title: Swiss penalty-clause discussion: 1988 authority
summary: The opening Swiss excerpt describes judicial reduction of an excessive contractual penalty and the considerations relevant to that determination.
notes:
The supplied material distinguishes the parties’ agreement to a penalty from the court’s power to reduce an excessive amount. Its discussion supplies a comparative point of reference for the U.S. cases’ treatment of liquidated damages and penalties.

The later 2024 decision in the same packet is separately indexed because its concrete facts and application should not be attributed to this earlier authority. This opening extract does not supply a complete factual and procedural record from which to construct a full six-part case brief.

textbookImport.basis: Paraphrase of the actual Fall 2026 course supplement. The source retains its own date and legal context; no current-law verification.

topics.stipulated-remedies: The excerpt illustrates reduction of a penalty rather than automatic importation of the domestic rule.
topics.remedies: Its remedial mechanism must be kept distinct from compensation.
